title: AgentsStep
description: agents.step@1 (one agent system, 2026-11-12): one entry of a run's append-only step log, as GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/steps returns it and as agents.step.appended@1 publishes it. SEQ is the run's own order (1, 2, …), never renumbered; a reader pages with ?after=SEQ. KIND says what the entry is: think (a plan, a check, a note to self), tool (a tool call or its result), message (words for the person), approval (the run asked), child (a sub-agent or a hand-off) or file (a file the run made). TEXT is what a person reads; TOOL_CALL is the tool's name and input on a tool entry; RESULT is what came back. The product's own event may split a call and its result into two steps: both carry KIND tool and the call's seq is the earlier one. A step carries no credential, no key and no token; a secret a tool saw is redacted before it is stored. Since 1.1.0 (agent-engine.md) a step also says who spoke (FROM: the person's own words are steps too), whether it is still under way (STATUS), a short TITLE and GLYPH for a tool or a thought, the files that go with it (ATTACHMENTS), numbered SOURCES, a rich card (UI) and, where a computer was used, the DESK picture and action for replay. Every added field is optional.

run_id.description: The run this step belongs to (agents.run@1's id).

seq.description: The run's own order for this entry, starting at 1 and never renumbered. ?after=SEQ reads the entries after it.

kind.description: think: a plan, a check or reasoning. tool: a tool call or its result. message: words for the person. approval: the run asked its person. child: a sub-agent run or a hand-off. file: a file the run made.

text.description: What a person reads for this step: the plan line, the message, the short tool answer or the file's name. Never a prompt or a secret.

tool_call.description: The tool this entry called. On a product that logs a call and its result as two steps, the call names the tool and the result entry has no TOOL_CALL.

input.description: The call's input, as the product recorded it: an object, a short summary string, or null. Credential-shaped fields are already redacted.

result.description: What the step answered: a tool's output, a check's verdict, a file's reference. Any JSON; never a credential.

cost.description: What this step spent, when the product meters per step. Null when it meters per run only.

ended_at.description: When the step ended, when the product records an end. A product that logs a point event sets it to the event's time; null when the step is still open.

child_run.description: The child run this step started, on KIND child. Null elsewhere.

from.description: Who this entry is from. person: the run's person (their message). agent: the agent. system: the product (a notice, a limit reached). tool: a tool's own words. Absent means agent.

author.description: Who spoke, when a thread has several people or agents: a name and a picture. Absent for the run's own person and agent.

status.description: Whether the entry is still under way (a tool that runs, a message being written). Absent means done.

title.description: The entry in a few words, for a tool or a thought: "Searching the web", "Reading 3 files".

glyph.description: A glyph's name in the openvibe-shared glyph registry (openvibe.design/icons). A reader that does not know it draws its default.

items.description: A file that goes with a message or a start: by its OpenVibe.Media id, or by an https address.

url.description: An https address the reader may fetch.

alt.description: What a picture shows, in words.

sources.description: The sources a message cites, numbered as its text cites them ([1], [2]).

ui.description: A rich card for this entry. TYPE names it (link, table, code, diff, image, choice, timer, repo, desk, run, or a product's own, prefixed with its product: live-clip); DATA is that card's own content. A reader that does not know the type shows TEXT instead, so TEXT always says the same thing in words.

desk.description: The computer this step used, for the screen tile and the replay: the desk, the picture it saw and what it did. A secret field is blanked before a still is stored.
